messages:
sara: FYI — escalation from Alex (customer). After we flipped the v5.8 canary to 10% in us-west, they're seeing tool call failures: schema validation rejects and some args look shuffled/serialized. Customer says it started exactly after the model swap.

alex-cust: Repro steps we gave: 1) POST /v1/exec with model=redwood/v5.8 2) body: {
```
{
  \"input\": \"Find address for id\",
  \"tool_request\": {
    \"tool_name\": \"address_lookup\",
    \"args\": {\"id\": 1234, \"country\": \"US\"}
  }
}
```
We get error: \"schema: missing field 'destination'\" and response tool args in logs look like: \"args\": \"{\\\"id\\\":1234,\\\"country\\\":\\\"US\\\"}\" (stringified).

sara: Logs from our side (sampling):
```
2026-03-15T15:22:11Z runtime: request_id=req-9a3f tool_resolver: model=redwood/v5.8 selected=address_lookup args_type=stringified
2026-03-15T15:22:11Z validator: request_id=req-9a3f tool=address_lookup schema_err=destination: missing
2026-03-15T15:22:11Z router: request_id=req-9a3f fallback_triggered=true -> model=redwood/v5.6
```

raj: :eyes: can you paste a full request id from the case? need to correlate with proxy/gateway logs and the JSON encoder bits.

alex-cust: case# 2026-1345, sample req id req-9a3f included above. Happening ~12/15 calls during their workflow after canary. Not all customers impacted.

marta: This smells like a model-specific tool-arg serializer change. v5.8 updated the \"tool-call shaping\" head (we changed a default to allow raw strings for legacy callers). Looks like for some prompts the model emits JSON as a string rather than structured object and the tool resolver isn't coercing back. I'm going to reproduce locally with the same prompt and model weights pinned.

marta: Repro (local):
```
# reproduce with SDK
from redwood import Client
c = Client(model='redwood/v5.8')
resp = c.exec({\"input\": \"Find address for id\", \"tool_request\": {\"tool_name\": \"address_lookup\", \"args\": {\"id\": 1234, \"country\": \"US\"}}})
print(resp.output)
```
Got: tool_request.args -> '\"{\\\"id\\\":1234,\\\"country\\\":\\\"US\\\"}\"' (double-stringified in some beam samples).

leo: Does v5.8 change any tokenization or serialization plugins in runtime? Could be serialization shim mismatch between runtime and model output format. Also seeing a tiny latency bump for canary customers (p50 +12ms).

marta: Confirmed: model-side change to response formatting heuristics. Not a routing bug. It's producing args as a quoted JSON blob when certain prompt templates are used (weird interplay with function-call templates).

raj: Impact risk: schema rejections -> higher error rate -> customer-facing failures and retries -> potential billing/retry storms. We should stop canary and revert model selection policy while we patch. Anyone object to pausing canary?

leo: +1 rollback. I'll coordinate. deploy-bot, can we rollback v5.8 -> v5.6 for canary fraction?

deploy-bot: Triggered rollback: patch: rollback-model-canary-3011122334, started by leo, ETA ~7m. Logs: deploy-evt-8b9f.

sara: Notifying customer and flagging for SE follow-up. Alex, we'll pause the canary and ask for patience. Sorry for the disruption.

alex-cust: Thanks — appreciate quick action. They rely on toolcall for production batch runs, so glad you're rolling back.

marta: Plan: 1) revert canary -> done 2) create a model patch that forces structured output for tool_request (escape detection) and add unit tests for the new code-path 3) add a runtime defensive coercer: if tool args are JSON string, attempt parse before validation 4) run a narrow A/B on the fix (small fraction) and monitor schema error rate.

raj: Also add alert rule: if tool schema validation errors > 0.5% for any model variant in production for 5 min, trigger page.

leo: Filing a post-mortem template now. Assigning action owners: marta -> model patch, raj -> runtime coercer + alert, sara -> customer comms, leo -> rollback validation and postmortem.

marta: I'll add regression tests and a small smoke canary with synthetic prompts.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: deploy-evt-8b9f -> success at 2026-03-15T15:31:02Z. Canary fraction set to 0% for redwood/v5.8 in us-west.

sara: Closing loop with customer now, will paste follow-up in this thread when done.

leo: :white_check_mark: good job team.
